title: Beam search with EOS and length normalization
summary: Keep the best beam_width partial sequences over a step function, finish beams at EOS, and rank them with a length penalty.

mutants.drop_unfinished: Forgets the alive hypotheses when the loop reaches max_len, so sequences without EOS are lost.
mutants.eos_stays_alive: Never moves EOS candidates to the finished list, so the search extends sequences past EOS.
mutants.length_counts_bos: Counts BOS in the length of the length penalty.
mutants.prune_per_beam: Keeps the best beam_width tokens of each beam and never prunes over all candidates.
mutants.ties_high_id: Sorts with reverse=True on (score, tokens), so equal scores put the higher token ids first.
mutants.unfinished_not_normalized: Adds the alive hypotheses at max_len with their raw scores, so the length penalty skips them.
